// Exact function extracts from the original 0.7.20 src/App.tsx. Test fixture only.
async function api<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}, token = ""): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(options.headers || {});
  if (options.body && !headers.has("Content-Type")) headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
  if (token) headers.set("X-MinerDesk-Token", token);
  const base = resolveApiBase();
  const url = `${base}${path}`;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
  let r: Response;
  try {
    r = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers, signal: options.signal || controller.signal });
  } finally {
    window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
  const text = await r.text();
  let body: any = {};
  if (text) {
    try {
      body = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      const preview = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 120);
      throw new Error(`MinerDesk API returned non-JSON data for ${url}: ${preview}`);
    }
  }
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(body.error || `${r.status} ${r.statusText}`);
  return body as T;
}

  async function saveConfig(next = config): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!next) return false; setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api("/api/config", { method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify(next) }, token);
      localStorage.setItem("minerdesk.web.port", String(next.web.desktop_api_port || 17888));
      localStorage.setItem("minerdesk.web.token", next.web.token || "");
      localStorage.setItem("minerdesk.language", next.ui.language || "en");
      if (isTauri) {
        try {
          await invoke("set_start_with_windows", { enabled: next.ui.start_with_windows ?? false });
          await invoke("set_close_to_tray", { enabled: next.ui.close_to_tray ?? false });
        } catch (e) {
          setToken(next.web.token || token); setDirty(false);
          setStatusText(`${t("saveOk")} · ${t("windowsIntegrationError")}: ${String(e)}`);
          return true;
        }
      }
      setToken(next.web.token || token); setDirty(false); setStatusText(t("saveOk"));
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      setStatusText(`Save: ${String(e)}`);
      return false;
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function minerAction(id: string, action: "start"|"stop"|"restart") {
    // Starting/restarting always persists the current form snapshot first. This
    // guarantees the backend rebuilds the miner command with the latest tuning
    // values instead of a previously saved core clock. Stop must not wait for
    // saving edits; pending edits remain visible and are saved on the next Start.
    if ((action === "start" || action === "restart") && config) {
      const saved = await saveConfig(config);
      if (!saved) return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api(`/api/miners/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: "POST" }, token);
      setStatusText(`${t("commandSent")}: ${action}`); setStatuses(await api<MinerStatus[]>("/api/status", {}, token));
    } catch (e) { setStatusText(String(e)); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
